title: Version sentinel
description: Served at /latest/version.json. A tiny, aggressively edge-cacheable file the static page polls with If-None-Match so a reader currently viewing the portal sees new stories within the poll interval, without the origin doing per-user work. The value v is a content fingerprint over the newest articles in display order, byte-stable when nothing changed (the edge answers 304) and changing the moment the top of the site does. latest_ids are those articles' slugs, newest first. Field set is frozen.

v.description: Hex SHA-256 content fingerprint of the latest window; identical bytes mean nothing changed.

latest_ids.description: Slugs of the newest articles in display order (newest first).
